items.quote: Jay & Norman Plumbing Services is fast, reliable, and honest. They diagnosed our plumbing issue in minutes and had it fixed without upselling. Highly recommend!

Jay and Norman Plumbing Services did a great job! They were professional, on time, and fixed the issue quickly. Best pricing I got after calling several plumbers. I'd definitely recommend them if you need reliable plumbing work.

I had a great experience with Jay and highly recommend his services. He replaced the old, rusty pipes in my home with new PVC piping, and the difference is incredible. From start to finish, he was professional, punctual, and clearly knowledgeable about his work.
